articles.title: Wireless electrocatalytic closed-loop system for drug-free management of diabesity
articles.summary: The wireless ECHO implant uses electrocatalysis for glucose control and can interface with a commercial continuous glucose monitor. The study reports glucose normalization within 1 h in diabetic mice and six weeks of treatment. Its closed-loop architecture offers a reference for wireless therapeutic systems.

articles.title: Cortex-wide imaging in naturally behaving mice with 1-gram wireless mesoscopes
articles.summary: The 1.0 g Airscope records more than 8,500 neurons per animal across a 6 mm field of view at 12.5 Hz. Demonstrations include swimming and simultaneous recordings from multiple animals or brain and spinal cord, with relevance to monitoring during natural behaviour.

articles.title: Body-clock disruptions contribute to one in four cases of depression, suggests large study
articles.summary: This Nature news report discusses population-level associations between circadian disruption and depression. It provides context for longitudinal physiological monitoring rather than a new sensing technology.

articles.title: Fabric user interface can be worn on your sleeve — and machine-washed
articles.summary: This Nature commentary discusses a machine-washable textile interface that integrates display, touch sensing and wireless interaction. The associated research article is also included in this edition.

articles.title: Touch-sensing digital pixel fibre enables interactive garment GUI
articles.summary: Digital pixel fibres integrate display, touch localization, computation and multimodal input/output. A sleeve prototype provides 96 × 54 pixels at 30 fps with 8-bit colour, alongside flexibility, breathability and washability.

articles.title: Large-scale iontronic skins with neural-hierarchical processing architecture
articles.summary: A hierarchical iontronic skin combines more than 10,000 sensing units, a density of 1,110 units cm⁻² and parallel readout at 100 fps. Frequency-position encoding and hierarchical compression address crosstalk and bandwidth; a robot resolves 300 μm surface features.

articles.title: Bioresorbable metal-free molecular magnets enable untethered organ monitoring
articles.summary: Bioresorbable metal-free molecular magnets based on modified graphitic carbon nitride are integrated into epicardial patches or injectable hydrogels. External Hall arrays support organ readout with motion-artifact suppression; a porcine study tracks ejection fraction over four weeks. The material and readout approach is relevant to resorbable magnetic implants.

articles.title: Millisecond phonon lifetimes in piezoelectric nanomechanical resonators
articles.summary: Surface repair after ion milling and shadow-mask metallization reduce losses in lithium-niobate nanomechanical resonators. The study reports phonon lifetimes up to 21 ms at 3.6 GHz and quality factors above 4 × 10⁸, with fabrication lessons for resonant sensors.

articles.title: Bioinspired supramolecular thermistor for resolving subtle temperature variations
articles.summary: A bioinspired supramolecular thermistor resolves subtle temperature changes. Its material design offers a reference for temperature channels and compensation in multimodal soft sensors.

articles.title: Extended field-of-view two-photon imaging in the deep brain of freely behaving mice using lightweight microfabricated corrective optics
articles.summary: Lightweight microfabricated corrective optics extend the field of view for deep-brain two-photon imaging in freely behaving mice. The approach offers hardware-design lessons for readout during natural movement.

articles.title: Local control of Cre-regulated genetic modeling in vivo using wireless implantable optoelectronics
articles.summary: Wireless implantable optoelectronics provide local control of Cre-regulated genetic models in vivo. Device miniaturization, wireless power and local stimulation are relevant to battery-free implantable systems.

articles.title: Magnetically gated millimeter-scale capsule power system for leadless electrotherapy
articles.summary: A millimetre-scale capsule uses a reed switch for magnetically gated power delivery and demonstrates cardiac pacing in large animals. The system offers an approach to leadless electrotherapy and externally triggered implants.

articles.title: Magneto-mechano-electrochemical fiber for deformation-resilient and smart electronic textiles
articles.summary: A magneto-mechano-electrochemical fibre regulates ion transport and combines motion-energy harvesting with magnetoelastic sensing. In its undeformed state, the study reports battery-lifetime and capacity increases of (374 ± 79)% and (61 ± 20)%, respectively, at 1.0 A g⁻¹.

articles.title: Mechanoadaptive nanowire viscoplastic composites with strain-enhanced conductivity for reprocessable bioelectronic interfaces
articles.summary: Mechanoadaptive nanowire viscoplastic composites show strain-enhanced conductivity and can be reprocessed into bioelectronic interfaces. The work offers material-design ideas for electrodes and interconnects under repeated deformation.

articles.title: Ultrasound-driven electronically programmable microbubbles
articles.summary: Ultrasound-driven microbubbles with electronic programmability offer a route to remote acoustic actuation and local responses. The concept may inform wireless systems for access to deep tissue.

articles.title: Regenerable, closed-loop, nonenzymatic continuous glucose monitoring enabled by in situ electrochemical interfacial alkalinization
articles.summary: A wrist-worn hollow-microneedle system extracts interstitial fluid and uses electrochemical interfacial alkalinization for nonenzymatic glucose measurement. Demonstrations include quasi-continuous monitoring in rats and an initial test in one person. A removable sensor cartridge addresses maintenance of the skin interface.

articles.title: Author Correction: Coaxially printed magnetic mechanical electrical hybrid structures with actuation and sensing functionalities
articles.summary: This author correction concerns printed magnetic–mechanical–electrical hybrid structures with combined actuation and sensing. It is retained as a correction, not as a report of new experimental results.

articles.title: mechanoLight: A genetically encoded fluorescent biosensor for visualizing 5-HT2AR mechanotransduction in live cells
articles.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
articles.summary: The genetically encoded fluorescent biosensor mechanoLight visualizes 5-HT2AR mechanotransduction in living cells. The approach provides a reference for optical interrogation of biochemical and mechanical signal transduction.

articles.title: First-principles channel model and capacity-achieving transmission scheme in thermal noise backscatter links
articles.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
articles.summary: A first-principles channel model and capacity-achieving scheme address backscatter transmission in thermal noise. The analysis is relevant to link budgets and decoding at low signal-to-noise ratios in passive wireless readout.

articles.title: Biodegradable Capacitive‐Coupling Bioelectronics for Wireless Electrical Stimulation and Longitudinal Electrophysiological Monitoring of Peripheral Nerve Regeneration
articles.summary: Biodegradable capacitive-coupling bioelectronics combine wireless electrical stimulation, nerve guidance and longitudinal compound-action-potential recording. A rat sciatic-nerve model demonstrates recovery trends consistent with wired electrophysiology, with relevance to resorbable implants and external coupling.

articles.title: Bridging Biosensing and Hardware‐Level Data Security With a Conjugated Radical Polymer
articles.summary: A conjugated radical polymer connects biosensing with hardware-level data security. The concept offers a potential route to secure encoding in distributed wearable or implantable nodes.

articles.title: Minimally Invasive In Vivo Fabrication of Multiscale Biohybrid Systems
articles.summary: Minimally invasive in vivo fabrication offers a material and integration route to multiscale biohybrid systems. The approach may inform in situ formation and delivery of complex implants.

articles.title: Strain‐Insensitive Conductors for Stretchable Electronics
articles.summary: This work examines structural strategies for strain-insensitive conductors in stretchable electronics. These strategies are relevant to interconnect stability, fatigue and suppression of deformation-related readout changes.

articles.title: Nanomesh Bioelectronics Inspired by Basement Membrane for In Situ Monitoring of Oxidative Stress at the Alveolar-Capillary Barrier
articles.summary: Basement-membrane-inspired nanomesh bioelectronics monitor oxidative stress at the alveolar–capillary barrier. The ultrathin interface offers a reference for conformal bioelectronics and local chemical sensing.

articles.title: Nanoedge-Regulated Impedance Sensing for Sensitive Cardiomyocyte Mechanophysiological Investigation and Functional Drug Assessment
articles.summary: Nanoedge-regulated impedance sensing tracks cardiomyocyte mechanophysiology and supports functional drug assessment. The approach links cellular mechanical states to continuous electrical readout.

articles.title: Flexible Microlaser Emitter for Mechanical Sensing and Pulse Mapping
articles.summary: A flexible microlaser emitter supports mechanical sensing and pulse mapping. The optical readout offers a complementary route to flexible biomechanical monitoring.

articles.title: Unveiling the Creep Recovery Behavior of Pseudo-Free-Standing Polymer Thin Films for Wearable Electronics
articles.summary: This study examines creep recovery in pseudo-free-standing polymer thin films. Its findings are relevant to long-term drift, fatigue and mechanical stability of wearable substrates and packaging.

articles.title: A fabrication-aware vectorized generative representation for topology optimization of path-defined MEMS microstructures
articles.summary: A vectorized design representation embeds linewidth, spacing and smoothness constraints into MEMS topology optimization. Reported examples reduce microheater temperature variation from 4.04% to 1.22% and increase microspring displacement by 30.6% with a 16.3% reduction in peak stress.

articles.title: Focusing and weighing microanalytes in liquid enabled by higher-order piezoelectric resonant membranes
articles.summary: Higher-order piezoelectric resonant membranes focus particles in droplets near regions of maximum vibration and then weigh them by resonance. The integrated actuation–sensing platform is relevant to liquid-phase mass sensing, fluid damping and mechanical biochemical readout.

articles.title: Towards advanced motion control systems for micro-scale magnetic drillers inside viscoelastic media
articles.summary: An eight-solenoid field generator controls 250 × 250 × 1,250 μm magnetic microdrillers within a 20 × 20 × 20 cm³ workspace. In 0.6 wt% agarose, the study reports speeds up to 155 μm s⁻¹ and steering errors below 3°, with relevance to actuation in viscoelastic media.

articles.title: Multiplexed sensor arrays for high-spatiotemporal decoding of complex physiological networks
articles.summary: This review compares temporal, frequency, spatial, optical, code and hybrid multiplexing. It discusses signal integrity, calibration, materials, mechanics, power and data processing for distributed physiological sensing arrays.

articles.title: Machine learning–driven structural optimization of zigzag silk fibroin ionic conductors for spatially resolved wearable motion detection
articles.summary: A surrogate model trained on 3,000 zigzag silk-fibroin conductor geometries guides structural optimization. A ten-channel device retains spatial fingerprints during joint bending, with Spearman correlations of 0.75–0.84; the workflow may transfer to flexible-array design.

articles.title: A Starfish‐Inspired Hierarchical Multimodal Flexible Sensor for Decoupled Thumb Motion Perception and Virtual Human–Machine Interaction
articles.summary: A starfish-inspired sensor separates radial strain channels from isolated pressure nodes to decouple global deformation and local touch. The study reports 99.27% test accuracy for six thumb motions, with relevance to wearable human–machine interfaces.

articles.title: Bio‐Derived Polyurethane Ionoelastomers With Hierarchical Dynamic Networks for Ultrawide‐Range Iontronic Pressure Sensing
articles.summary: Bio-derived polyurethane ionoelastomers use hierarchical dynamic networks for wide-range iontronic pressure sensing. The material strategy may inform the balance between sensing range and sensitivity in soft tactile devices.

articles.title: Flexible Neuromorphic Softness Sensory System
articles.summary: A flexible neuromorphic system distinguishes softness. The approach offers a reference for array-level processing of tactile and tissue-mechanics signals.

articles.title: A Standardized Chewable Conductive Hydrogel Sensor for Direct Monitoring of Masticatory Dynamics
articles.summary: A standardized chewable conductive-hydrogel sensor directly records masticatory dynamics. It provides a reference for intraoral mechanical monitoring and durable soft sensing interfaces.

articles.title: Macrophage–Fibroblast Crosstalk Governs Tumor Mechanics, as Revealed by Spatiotemporal Force Mapping in 3D Spheroids
articles.summary: Spatiotemporal force mapping in three-dimensional spheroids reveals how macrophage–fibroblast interactions affect tumour mechanics. The method offers a reference for quantitative studies of tissue mechanics and the mechanical microenvironment.

articles.title: Self‐Powered, Neural Network‐Inspired Mechanical Intelligence Driven by Triboelectric Nanogenerators
articles.summary: Triboelectric nanogenerators support a self-powered mechanical-intelligence system. The architecture may inform local encoding and low-power processing in distributed tactile nodes.

articles.title: Decoupling Gauge Factor and Baseline Resistance Through Crack–Percolation Hybrid Design for Flexible Multimodal Strain Sensors
articles.summary: A crack–percolation hybrid design decouples gauge factor from baseline resistance in flexible strain sensors. The design addresses independent tuning of sensitivity and electrical readout.

articles.title: Property-level analysis of environment-dependent piezoelectric resonant microcantilever mass sensors: Multi-metric sensitivity and Pareto screening
articles.summary: An analysis of 25 piezoelectric microcantilever material combinations compares performance in air and water. Reported AlN–SiC sensitivities are 1.10 and 0.025 Hz pg⁻¹, respectively; Sobol and Pareto analyses show that material selection depends on the medium and readout metric.

articles.title: Leaky-Wave Antenna for Non-Invasive Continuous Glucose Monitoring
articles.summary: This preprint uses fixed-frequency phase measurements from a leaky-wave antenna to estimate glucose-dependent dielectric changes. Tests in two participants report correlations of 0.939 and 0.906 against reference glucose values. This is an early proof of concept and has not been peer reviewed.

articles.title: Microrobot and Cellbot Locomotion in Confined Hydrogels and Cardiac Tissue Surfaces
articles.summary: This preprint compares magnetic microrobot and cellbot locomotion in dishes, hydrogels and ex vivo cardiac tissue. Rotating-field frequency, fibre orientation and cell adhesion affect trajectories and speed. The work has not been peer reviewed.

articles.title: Ultra-high-efficacy Wireless Neuromodulation Using a Conductive Ring Interface
articles.summary: This theoretical and COMSOL preprint proposes a conductive-ring implant for magnetic neuromodulation. At 10 kHz and 1 kA m⁻¹, the model predicts a local field of ~50 V m⁻¹ across a gap. Experimental validation is still required; the work has not been peer reviewed.

articles.title: Dual-MOF encapsulated smart gel electrolyte for plant-wearable electrochemical detection of organophosphate pesticides
articles.summary: A plant-wearable electrochemical patch uses acid-responsive ZIF-8 nanocontainers to separate an enzyme from its substrate until activation. A conformal MXene hydrogel supports leaf attachment. The reported phoxim detection limit is 2.8 ng/mL; the material-controlled activation method may inform other flexible biochemical sensors.

articles.title: Distinct patterns of whole-body coding in human motor cortex and posterior parietal cortex
articles.summary: Single-neuron recordings in people with tetraplegia reveal different patterns of body-part representation in motor and posterior parietal cortex. The distinction offers adjacent context for the choice of neural recording sites and signals in brain–machine interfaces.

articles.title: A Sensitive BLE-Enabled Wearable fNIRS Biosensor for Real-Time Monitoring and Mapping of Task-Evoked Oxygen Influxes During On-Screen Cognitive Tasks
articles.summary: A four-channel wearable fNIRS device combines optical acquisition with Bluetooth Low Energy transmission for cable-free hemodynamic recording. Vascular, breath-hold and cognitive tasks validate its responses. The work also proposes a task-evoked oxygenation metric, with potential relevance to wearable measurements of cognitive engagement.

articles.title: An Improved Fabrication Method for Flexible COC-Based Implantable Neural Probes with Reliability Validation
articles.summary: Flexible neural probes combine T-die-cast cyclic olefin copolymer films, femtosecond laser machining and iridium oxide electrodes. The study reports 681.04 ohms impedance at 1 kHz and insulation leakage below 1 nA after 320 days of accelerated soaking at 75 °C. These results concern fabrication and accelerated reliability, rather than long-term clinical validation.

articles.title: Function-based Deep Learning Autoencoder for Passive Shimming in a Portable MRI Magnet with Enhanced Field Homogeneity
articles.summary: A self-supervised autoencoder optimizes the distribution of passive ferromagnetic shims in a portable MRI magnet. The study reports an improvement in field homogeneity from 4,873 to 547 ppm. The optimization method offers a transferable reference for magnetic-field design, although the demonstrated application is MRI.
